title: Directional Transitions, Gap Rules, Proportional Type, Glass Xylophone & Agent Status
description: Five live drops: type-matched view transitions, grid gap dividers, self-scaling letter-spacing, a hover-ringing glass xylophone, and a spinner-free agent status stack.

drops.title: Directional View Transitions
drops.description: One view-transition call drives four opposite outcomes via CSS type-matching, not branching JS.
drops.concept: document.startViewTransition({update, types}) tags a transition with a semantic type (forward/backward/success/error). CSS then reads the active type via html:active-view-transition-type() to pick completely different ::view-transition-old()/new() keyframes for the same pseudo-elements — one call site, many visual outcomes, with a safe fallback for browsers lacking the API.

interaction.mouse: Click Prev/Next to slide the deck, or the success/error buttons to trigger the form outcome
interaction.click: Each button starts a differently-typed view transition

drops.title: Gap Decorations Ledger
drops.description: A ledger grid whose divider lines live in the gap itself via row-rule/column-rule, no extra borders.
drops.concept: CSS Gap Decorations let a grid or flex container draw row-rule/column-rule lines directly inside its own gutters, with rule-overlap controlling how row and column rules cross. This demo toggles between the native gap-drawn rules and the pre-2026 border-right/border-bottom workaround so the difference is obvious, and degrades gracefully via @supports where the property isn't available yet.
drops.source: CSS-Tricks — CSS Gap Decorations Now Available

interaction.mouse: Adjust rule width/style/mode in the debug panel
interaction.click: Toggle mode dropdown swaps native rules vs fallback borders
interaction.touch: Panel hidden on small screens; grid still renders

drops.title: Proportional Type Spacing
drops.description: Percentage letter-spacing scales itself with font-size, and native text-justify replaces JS word-spacing hacks.
drops.concept: letter-spacing and word-spacing now accept percentage values that scale proportionally with the element's own font-size, so a headline keeps the same visual spacing ratio whether it's 18px or 80px — no more per-breakpoint overrides. Paired with text-justify: inter-word/inter-character, the browser distributes a justified paragraph's slack natively instead of through manual word-spacing math.
drops.source: Chrome for Developers — New in Chrome

interaction.mouse: Drag sliders to resize font and spacing amount, switch text-justify mode
interaction.touch: Sliders are touch-draggable on the visible cards

drops.title: Glass Xylophone
drops.description: Hover-ringing glass bars swing on a stateless damped pendulum and reveal color only in the cursor's wake.
drops.concept: Each glass bar plays a pentatonic Web Audio pluck on pointer entry and swings back using a purely time-based damped-cosine formula (angle = amplitude · e^(-damping·t) · cos(freq·t)) evaluated fresh every animation frame from a single strike timestamp — no stored velocity or spring state per bar. A shared color-gradient overlay is CSS-masked by a radial gradient that follows the cursor, so each bar's true hue only shows through where the pointer's wake has passed.
drops.source: Sujen Phea — Building an Endless Interactive Glass Xylophone (Codrops)

interaction.mouse: Hover or drag across the bars to ring and swing them
interaction.click: Sound toggle and sliders tune amplitude/damping/reveal radius
interaction.touch: Drag a finger across the bars on touch devices

drops.title: Agent Status Stack
drops.description: Four combinable patterns replace the spinner: living breadcrumb, step checklist, reasoning disclosure, and audit trail.
drops.concept: Instead of one opaque spinner, this status stack combines a low-key pulsing 'living breadcrumb' of the current phase, a checklist where each step shows pending/active/done/failed state individually, a collapsible 'show reasoning' log built on <details>, and a post-run audit trail with timestamps. Crucially it supports partial success — a run can finish with 3 of 4 steps done and one flagged failed, rather than forcing a binary success/spinner state.
drops.source: Victor Yocco — Practical Interface Patterns for AI Transparency (Smashing Magazine)

interaction.mouse: Click Run task or Run w/ partial failure to play through the sequence
interaction.click: Show reasoning expands the live log; Show work reveals the audit trail after completion
